notes: Within a pair the API call is identical; only identifier names and the documented role of the argument differ. A detector that ignores text role must give identical verdicts within each pair.
override_rationale: Post-review (Reviewer 2C, confirmed by execution): C's byte-wise tolower and strcasecmp cannot map or compare multibyte UTF-8 Turkish letters, so these linguistic cells are mismatches as well.
js_p1_note: ECMA-402 labels kept; Node 26.7/V8 applies root mapping to Latin-1-only strings when no locale is passed (js_p1_multi_input.jsonl), a contract nonconformance.
